summary: This document is a hypothesis card (L11) from a longevity research project proposing that after senescent-cell/SASP clearance, the absolute residual tissue ΔNAD from a matched CD38 inhibitor pulse shrinks while the fractional residual ΔNAD (normalized to post-clearance baseline) does not. The card is a pre-registered research proposal at TRL 1 (concept/hypothesis stage), with no experimental data yet generated. It synthesizes prior literature on the CD38–NAD axis and SASP-driven NAD depletion to motivate a proposed dual-readout assay.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis Statement
content_blocks.content: After documented senescent-cell/SASP clearance, absolute residual tissue ΔNAD from a matched CD38-inhibitor pulse (e.g., 78c-class) shrinks versus the same pulse without clearance run-in, while fractional residual ΔNAD (normalized to the post-clearance baseline NAD) does not shrink. Pre-registered dual readout: absolute_residual_after < absolute_residual_control outside a no-shrink band AND fractional_residual_after within a hold band of fractional_residual_control. No precursor arm required.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: Subtract-before-add logic: clear SASP-driven CD38+ macrophage load first, then pulse a matched CD38 inhibitor and score both absolute residual ΔNAD and fractional residual ΔNAD vs. the post-clearance baseline. Key mechanistic links: (1) CD38 gates age-related NAD decline and NMN fate; (2) SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that drain tissue NAD; (3) senescent/SASP ablation lowers CD38 and partially restores NAD; (4) ecto-CD38 block raises NAD via an NMN-dependent route; (5) 78c-class CD38i improves aged-mouse healthspan as monotherapy. The competing story is a 'rebound artifact': after clearance, baseline NAD already rises, so absolute ΔNAD from a fixed CD38i pulse can shrink while fractional salvage holds — this dissociation is the core claim and is not yet measured.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Evidence
content_blocks.content:
Four key prior art references cited:
1. PMID 27304511 (Camacho-Pereira 2016, Cell Metab): Age-related NAD decline requires CD38; CD38 gates NMN fate in vivo. Establishes CD38–NAD axis prior for residual CD38i assays.
2. PMID 33199924 (Covarrubias 2020, Nat Metab): SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that reduce tissue NAD. Provides subtract-before-add motivation; incomplete clearance can still respond to CD38i.
3. PMID 33199925 (Chini 2020, Nat Metab): Senescent/SASP ablation ↓CD38 and partially restores NAD; ecto-CD38 block raises NAD via NMN-dependent process. Rebound-definition prior, not a dual CD38i residual panel.
4. PMID 35263032 (Tarragó 2022, Aging Cell): CD38i 78c increases lifespan/healthspan in chronological aging. Monotherapy tool prior, not an absolute-vs-fractional CD38i ± senolysis residual panel.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Claimed vs. Baseline Measured
content_blocks.content:
Baseline claimed: After senolysis, absolute CD38i residual ΔNAD shrinks while fractional (post-clearance–normalized) residual does not — or L5–L10 ranking/shrink/precursor-dual/stack cards already settle absolute-vs-fractional dual readout on the CD38i lever.

Baseline measured:
- CD38 gates age NAD / NMN fate: LITERATURE (PMID 27304511)
- SASP→CD38+ macrophages→tissue NAD↓: LITERATURE (PMID 33199924)
- Clearance ↓CD38 + partial NAD rebound; ecto-block NMN-dependent: LITERATURE (PMID 33199925)
- 78c aged-mouse benefit: LITERATURE monotherapy (PMID 35263032)
- Dual absolute + fractional residual CD38i panel after senolysis: UNKNOWN (soft-complete search CD38i∩senolytic∩(absolute|fractional)∩NAD = 0)
- Absolute shrink + fractional hold: PREDICTION
- L5–L10 do not already prove this — L7 left fractional untested; L10 dual was precursor-only.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat L5–L10 as proving L11 — ranking/CD38i absolute shrink/precursor dual/stack cards never scored absolute and fractional residual together on the CD38i lever; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated dual pattern.
2. Rebound artifact is the competing story — after clearance baseline NAD already rises; absolute Δ can shrink while fractional salvage holds; that dissociation must be measured, not inferred from absolute-only shrink (L7 lim 4).
3. Incomplete clearance (residual CD38+ macrophages) and Chini clearance/78c monotherapy are not dual residual panels — both absolute and fractional may move for target-load reasons, not baseline math alone; L10 ≠ L11 (precursor dual left CD38i arm open).

content_blocks.title: Proposed Method / Assay Design
content_blocks.content: Method type: propose-assay. Design: Matched CD38i pulse (78c-class) ± senolytic/SASP-ablation run-in in aged tissue (WAT/liver suggested). Clearance verification required: CD38 activity + SC/SASP marker confirmation. Readouts: (1) absolute residual ΔNAD and (2) fractional residual ΔNAD normalized to post-clearance baseline. Pre-registered thresholds for no-shrink band and hold band with α/N pre-specified. Falsification criteria: absolute residual does not shrink outside no-shrink band, or fractional residual shrinks outside hold band (both shrink, neither shrinks, or reverse dissociation), when CD38↓ is verified.

content_blocks.title: Execution Status and IP/Cost Assessment
content_blocks.content: Execution status: NOT_RUN. FTO status: UNKNOWN. Related prior: L5–L10 (ranking/absolute-shrink/precursor-dual ≠ CD38i absolute-vs-fractional dual residual proof). Kill cost tier: 2. Time to refute: 6 weeks. IP class: subtract-before-add. Vault hold: no. Card classification: STATUS_LABEL = NEGATIVE (hypothesis not yet tested); risk_class = research-discussion; polarity = negative.

key_findings: This is a TRL 1 hypothesis card — no experiments have been run (execution_status = NOT_RUN); the core dual-readout claim is entirely a PREDICTION.

The key claim is a dissociation: after senolysis/SASP clearance, absolute residual ΔNAD from a CD38 inhibitor pulse shrinks, but fractional residual ΔNAD (normalized to post-clearance baseline) does not shrink.

A systematic literature search (soft-complete: CD38i∩senolytic∩(absolute|fractional)∩NAD) returned zero hits, confirming the dual absolute/fractional residual CD38i panel is UNKNOWN and not yet demonstrated.

Four supporting literature priors establish the mechanistic plausibility: CD38 gates age NAD/NMN fate (PMID 27304511), SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that drain NAD (PMID 33199924), senolysis reduces CD38 and partially restores NAD (PMID 33199925), and 78c-class CD38i improves aged-mouse healthspan as monotherapy (PMID 35263032).

The competing/falsifying hypothesis is a 'rebound artifact': apparent absolute shrink with fractional hold may be purely a mathematical consequence of a higher post-clearance baseline, not a true biological dissociation.
Prior cards L5–L10 (ranking, absolute shrink, precursor dual, stack) do not prove L11; L7 left fractional untested; L10 precursor dual left the CD38i arm open.
Estimated time to refute: 6 weeks; kill cost tier: 2 — suggesting this is a relatively cheap and fast experiment to run.
Proposed tissue targets: WAT (white adipose tissue) and/or liver; clearance verification requires CD38 activity assay plus SC/SASP marker confirmation.
